sections.title: 3.0 REQUIREMENTS
sections.text_preview: The Mapping, Charting, Geodesy, and Imagery (MCG&I) requirements for the JMTK are: geospatial analysis, display, spatial database management, processing of local imagery and utilities.

sections.title: 3.1Required States and Modes
sections.text_preview: The states and modes in which the JMTK operate will be determined by the higher level application software that uses it, and is therefore, transparent to this common support application.

sections.text_preview: The decisions related to internal data requirements are made by NIMA in coordination with JMTK developers.

sections.title: 3.6Adaptation Requirements
sections.text_preview: The JMTK is a developer toolkit in which APIs and binaries have dependencies on the DII COE Kernel, COE Developer's Toolkit, and the COE Component Table segments. Toolkit modules will be provided for

sections.title: 3.7Safety Requirements
sections.text_preview: JMTK software will not interfere with or defeat the purpose of, safety functions implemented in the host system.

sections.title: 3.8Security and Privacy Requirements
sections.text_preview: DII COE Security Services will provide the JMTK security access. File access within the services of JMTK are controlled through the mission application. The user will be responsible for defining data

sections.title: 3.9CSCI Environmental Requirements
sections.text_preview: Ultimately, the JMTK is to be hardware independent and operate on a range of system platforms running under standards-based operating systems designated by DII (Refer to Paragraph 3.10.1 below).

sections.title: 3.10 Computer Resources Requirements
sections.text_preview: The JMTK will be compatible with DII-specified hardware and operating systems.

sections.title: 3.10.1 Computer Hardware Requirements
sections.text_preview: There is no hardware specific to the JMTK. The JMTK will be an open system capable of running on any DII COE approved platform. The approved Commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) platforms for DII 3.0 are H

sections.title: 3.10.3 Computer Software Requirements
sections.text_preview:
In addition to the operating system software, the most recent version of the following software items are recommended for JMTK Mission Application Developers:

• X-Windows X 11R6,

• Developers' Motif

sections.title: 3.10.4 Computer Communications Requirements
sections.text_preview: The DII hardware and software components will be configured to meet specific user needs. JMTK computer communications requirements are being considered in the design of the DII architecture.

sections.title: 3.11 Software Quality Factors
sections.text_preview: The software quality factors that have already been put in place by the Military Services for CHART, CMTK and TEM that are represented in the JMTK will be assumed.

sections.title: 3.12 Design and Implementation Constraints
sections.text_preview: JMTK will be compatible with DII-specified platforms and operating systems. Presently, DII COE developmental release 3.2 consists of Sun Solaris Version 2.5.1 and HP UX Version 10.20 with OS compatibl

sections.title: 3.13Personnel-related Requirements
sections.text_preview: The JMTK is a set of APIs and provides no direct user interface, although some of the helper applications for the visual domain use Motif-based dialog boxes. JMTK uses the standard default color map.

sections.title: 3.14Training-Related Requirements
sections.text_preview: JMTK, as a toolkit, has no training requirements.

sections.title: 3.15 Logistics-related Requirements
sections.text_preview: NIMA will provide software support for the JMTK. The DISA Engineering Office will distribute the JMTK.

sections.title: 3.16 Other Requirements
sections.text_preview: Not applicable.

sections.text_preview: Not applicable.

sections.title: 3.18 Precedence and Criticality of Requirements
sections.text_preview: Each military service or agency assigns their respective requirement precedence or criticality of requirement. Weights are to be assigned indicating the relative importance of each of the requirements

sections.title: 4.1Qualifications Methods
sections.text_preview: JMTK will be qualified through formal validation test of the SRS level requirements on DII COE specified hardware platforms and operating systems. The components will be tested by the developers prior

sections.title: 4.1.1 Demonstration (D)
sections.text_preview: The operation of the CSCI, or part of the CSCI, that relies on observable functional operation not requiring the use of instrumentation, special test equipment, or special analysis.

sections.title: 4.1.2 Test (T)
sections.text_preview: The operation of the CSCI, or part of the CSCI, using instrumentation or other special test equipment to collect data for later analysis.

sections.title: 4.1.3 Analysis (A)
sections.text_preview: The processing of accumulated data obtained from other qualification methods. Examples are reduction, interpretation, or extrapolation of test results.

sections.title: 4.1.4 Inspection (I)
sections.text_preview: The visual examination of CSCI code, documentation, etc.

sections.title: 4.1.5 Special Qualification Methods
sections.text_preview: Any qualification methods for the CSCI, such as special tools, techniques, procedures, facilities, and acceptance limits.
